additionalBuildings.footprintEvidence: Exterior from the author's 1891-96 OS building GeoPackage (reference/historic-building-footprints-2026-09-28/west-ham-buffer-buildings-bng.geojson.gz), sourceFids 236176, simplified at 0.15 m (max deviation 0.003 m), used unshifted in the GeoPackage frame; checked against the cached NLS OS London five-foot 1893 mosaic (scripts/factory_map_sources.py mosaic(), layer os-london-five-foot-1893), which draws it as a shaded (roofed) building. 9.91 x 8.63 m, 69.9 m2. Goad F3 lot 582 (Goad F3 (reference/city-mills-howards/goad-1893-vol-f-sheet-3.tiff, July 1893) locally re-registered to the GeoPackage outlines by a similarity fit starting from the project's regional goad-f3-marsh registration (shifted 8.04, -2.86 m; 0.15763 m per pixel; colour-overlap IoU 0.65; GeoPackage vertices a median 0.47 m, 90th percentile 2.39 m from the fitted Goad building edge)).
additionalBuildings.heightEvidence: Explicit estimate: 5.35 m eaves (builder value for 1 1/2 storeys); Goad F3 prints both 1 and 2 in its rooms; Goad F3 colours it pink (brick in the 1926 key).
additionalBuildings.roofEvidence: Explicit estimate: plain gable along the long axis, rise from the builder's 0.27 x bay-span rule. Goad F3 marks the roof T (tile in the 1926 Goad key, reference/factory-building-survey/goad-symbol-key-1926.jpg); the renderer draws its standard roof colour.
